evidence_proposition: On known chain, collider and lag-1 series, every graph-posterior engine puts at least the declared minimum posterior mass on the generating skeleton, orientation or lag edge.
limitations: The minimum masses are set just below the exact Gaussian-BIC posterior mass that the consuming test computes by its own 25-DAG enumeration, so they are thresholds tied to the implementation family rather than an independently derived posterior; only the generating structure is known by construction. No posterior calibration and no upstream-package comparison.
